headline: Amalgamation/Merger
summary: The National Company Law Tribunal (NCLT), Kolkata Bench, has admitted the second motion petition for the amalgamation of Somany Bathware Limited, Somany Excel Vitrified Private Limited, and SR Continental Limited into Somany Ceramics Limited, with the next hearing scheduled for August 28, 2026. The scheme, effective from April 1, 2025, proposes to transfer the business undertakings of the transferor companies to the transferee company, after which the transferor companies will be dissolved without winding up. The order was received by the company on July 27, 2026.

headline: Scheme of Arrangement
summary: Kitex Garments Limited has disclosed the voting results and scrutinizer's report for its Scheme of Arrangement, following meetings of equity shareholders and unsecured creditors held on July 24, 2026. The announcement confirms the outcome of the votes on the proposed scheme.

headline: General Updates
summary: Authum Investment & Infrastructure Limited, as part of a consortium with Inox Neo Energies Limited, has received NCLT approval for a resolution plan to acquire Wind World (India) Limited. Under the plan, Inox will take over the IPP, power sale, and O&M businesses, while Authum will acquire specific real estate assets. Authum's financial commitment in the plan is approximately INR 350 crore.

headline: Amalgamation/Merger
summary: Larsen & Toubro's board has approved a scheme to merge its wholly owned subsidiary, L&T Power Development Limited, into the parent company, followed by the subsidiary's dissolution. The board also approved the consolidated and standalone unaudited financial results for the quarter ended June 30, 2026, reporting revenues of ₹67,942 crore (up 7%) and a PAT of ₹4,123 crore. The merger is subject to regulatory approvals, including from the National Company Law Tribunal.

headline: General Updates
summary: Info Edge (India) Limited disclosed that the National Company Law Appellate Tribunal (NCLAT) has passed a judgment regarding its Scheme of Amalgamation. The announcement was made in compliance with SEBI Listing Regulations. Further details are available in the official filing.

headline: General Updates
summary: Inox Green Energy Services Limited announced that the NCLT Ahmedabad Bench has orally approved the resolution plan submitted by a consortium (including Inox Neo Energies and Authum) for Wind World (India) Limited. Under the plan, INOXGFL Group companies will acquire WWIL’s IPP, power sale, and O&M businesses, while Authum will acquire certain real estate and other assets. A detailed disclosure will follow once the written certified order is available.

headline: News Verification
summary: Go Digit General Insurance Limited confirmed that the stock exchange sought clarification regarding a news report on CCI clearing its merger with Go Digit Infoworks and Fairfax holding a 57.28% stake. The company provided its official response, which is attached to the announcement.

headline: General Updates
summary: SML Mahindra Limited's Board has approved the acquisition of Mahindra & Mahindra's Truck and Bus Division as a going concern on a slump sale basis for Rs. 525 crore. The deal, which includes all employees, assets, and liabilities of the division, is subject to shareholder approval and is expected to be finalized by August 7th, 2026.

headline: Sale or disposal
summary: Mahindra & Mahindra's Board has approved the sale of its Truck & Bus Division to its subsidiary, SML Mahindra Limited, for Rs. 525 crore via a slump sale. The division, which generated Rs. 2,989 crore in revenue last year, will be transferred as a going concern under a Business Transfer Agreement expected by August 7, 2026, with completion targeted by January 31, 2027.

headline: News Verification
summary: Go Digit General Insurance Limited has received a clarification request from the stock exchange regarding a news report that the Competition Commission of India (CCI) has cleared its merger with Go Digit Infoworks, with a Fairfax entity set to hold a 57.28% stake. The company has not yet provided its response to the exchange.

headline: General Updates
summary: Triveni Engineering & Industries Ltd. has provided a material update regarding its Composite Scheme of Arrangement involving Sir Shadi Lal Enterprises Limited and Triveni Power Transmission Ltd. The update pertains to the scheme under Sections 230-232 of the Companies Act, 2013. No further details on the specific nature of the update were disclosed in the announcement.

headline: Amalgamation/Merger
summary: Transindia Real Estate Limited has issued a notice to its equity shareholders following an NCLT Mumbai order regarding the amalgamation of its wholly owned subsidiary, Madanahatti Logistics and Industrial Parks Private Limited, into itself. The scheme involves merging the subsidiary with the holding company. This intimation was formally communicated to the stock exchange.

headline: General Updates
summary: ACC Limited has received an order from the National Company Law Tribunal (NCLT) directing it to convene a meeting of equity shareholders on September 29, 2026, to consider and vote on the proposed Scheme of Amalgamation with Ambuja Cements Limited. This order follows previous disclosures made in December 2025 and June 2026 regarding the merger scheme. The shareholder meeting will be conducted via video conference or other audio-visual means.

headline: General Updates
summary: Ambuja Cements has received an order from the NCLT, Ahmedabad Bench, directing it to convene a meeting of equity shareholders to consider and approve the proposed Scheme of Amalgamation of ACC Limited with Ambuja Cements. The meeting will be held via video conference on September 29, 2026, at 12:30 p.m. IST. This follows prior disclosures made on December 22, 2025, and June 4, 2026, regarding the amalgamation scheme.

headline: Demerger
summary: EFC (I) Limited's Board has approved a Scheme of Arrangement to demerge the asset-light managed office solutions business of its wholly owned subsidiary, EFC Limited, into EFC (I) Limited. This demerger will separate the leased commercial premises operations from the asset-intensive owned real estate business, with the demerged division accounting for 34.92% of EFC (I)'s consolidated turnover. The scheme is subject to regulatory approvals, including from the National Company Law Tribunal.

headline: Demerger
summary: EFC (I) Limited announced that its wholly owned subsidiary and related companies have approved the withdrawal of a proposed demerger scheme, originally intended to be executed via the fast-track merger route. The decision was made due to legal, regulatory, and operational considerations. An application to withdraw the scheme will be filed with the Regional Director in Mumbai.

headline: Scheme of Arrangement
summary: Siyaram Silk Mills Limited has disclosed, under SEBI regulations, the approval of a Scheme of Arrangement between the company and its shareholders. The announcement confirms that a certified copy of the relevant National Company Law Tribunal (NCLT) order has been received and enclosed. This marks a key regulatory step in implementing the approved restructuring plan.

headline: Scheme of Arrangement
summary: Astral Limited has decided to withdraw its proposed Composite Scheme of Arrangement following a recommendation from an independent consultant, who advised against proceeding due to the current scale of the Chemical Business. The Board concluded that the demerger is not in the best interests of the company or its shareholders at this stage, and may be reconsidered once the Chemical Business achieves sufficient scale and financial strength. The company will continue to evaluate other strategic initiatives to enhance shareholder value.

headline: Outcome of Board Meeting
summary: Astral Limited’s Board has decided to withdraw its proposed Composite Scheme of Arrangement following a recommendation from an Independent Consultant, who advised against proceeding due to the current scale of the Chemical Business. After reviewing feedback from stakeholders and market conditions, the Board concluded the demerger is not in the best interest of the company or shareholders at this stage. The company will reconsider the demerger once the Chemical Business achieves sufficient scale and financial strength.

headline: General Updates
summary: HEG Limited has notified shareholders holding physical shares to update their KYC details and dematerialize their holdings before the record date for the allotment of equity shares in HEG Graphite Limited. This action is required under the Composite Scheme of Arrangement. The company has issued this reminder to ensure smooth processing of the share allotment.

headline: Scheme of Arrangement
summary: Go Digit General Insurance Limited announced that the Competition Commission of India (CCI) has approved its proposed amalgamation with Go Digit Infoworks Services Private Limited. This approval follows earlier "no adverse observations" from the stock exchanges. The scheme still requires further approvals from the NCLT, IRDAI, and shareholders.

headline: Suspension of Trading
summary: Trading in equity shares of Winsome Yarns Limited will be suspended from July 31, 2026, following a reduction of share capital ordered by the NCLT. The suspension is effective from the specified date.

headline: Scheme of Arrangement
summary: UPL Limited has received observation letters from BSE and NSE regarding its Composite Scheme of Arrangement involving UPL, UPL SAS, UPL 2, and UPL Cayman 1. The scheme outlines a restructuring among these entities. This update confirms regulatory acknowledgment of the proposed arrangement.

headline: General Updates
summary: Zensar Technologies' Board has approved the merger of its US-based step-down subsidiaries, Bridgeview Life Sciences LLC and M3BI LLC, into its material wholly-owned subsidiary, Zensar Technologies Inc. The merger aims to achieve greater business synergies and operational efficiencies, and will result in the merging entities ceasing to exist as separate subsidiaries. No change in Zensar Technologies' shareholding pattern is expected from this transaction.

headline: Other Restructuring
summary: RPG Life Sciences Limited's Board approved the sale of its Active Pharmaceutical Ingredients (API) business to its wholly-owned subsidiary, RPG Active Pharma Limited (RPGAP), via a slump sale for approximately ₹33.55 crore. The Board also authorized an investment agreement involving RPGAP, India Life Sciences Fund IV Domestic, and Vistaject Fund, as well as a share purchase agreement for RPGAP to acquire Actis Generics Private Limited. The transaction, expected to close by September 30, 2026, is a related-party deal conducted at arm's length.

headline: Amalgamation/Merger
summary: Mahindra & Mahindra Limited announced the merger of its wholly owned subsidiary, Mahindra Investment Company (Mauritius) Limited, into itself. The merger aims to streamline the group structure by reducing complexity, and is exempt from related party transaction regulations as it involves a holding company and its wholly owned subsidiary. The transferor company holds investments, while Mahindra & Mahindra focuses on mobility products and farm solutions.

headline: Scheme of Arrangement
summary: Thermax Limited announced a Scheme of Arrangement to merge its wholly-owned subsidiary, Thermax Cooling Solutions Limited, into itself to simplify the group structure and reduce administrative overheads. The merger is expected to improve key financial ratios, generate annual cost savings, and enhance long-term shareholder value, with no change in Thermax's shareholding pattern. Additionally, the scheme includes the demerger of the EPC business of another wholly-owned subsidiary, Thermax Bioenergy Solutions Private Limited, which had a turnover of ₹239.35 crore in the last financial year.

headline: Demerger
summary: Thermax Limited announced a demerger scheme to simplify its group structure by consolidating its wholly-owned subsidiary, Thermax Cooling Solutions Limited, and demerging the EPC business of another subsidiary, Thermax Bioenergy Solutions Private Limited. The consolidation aims to reduce administrative overheads, improve key financial ratios, and generate annual cost savings, with no change in Thermax Limited's shareholding pattern. The demerged EPC business had a turnover of ₹239.35 crore, representing 3.67% of Thermax's total turnover.

headline: Amalgamation/Merger
summary: Thermax Limited has announced a scheme to merge its wholly-owned subsidiary, Thermax Cooling Solutions Limited, into itself to simplify the group structure, reduce administrative costs, and improve key financial ratios. Additionally, the company will demerge the EPC business of another wholly-owned subsidiary, Thermax Bioenergy Solutions Private Limited, which focuses on Bio-CNG projects. No new shares will be issued, and the shareholding pattern of Thermax Limited will remain unchanged.

headline: Updates
summary: Vedanta Limited has informed the stock exchange about its plan to demerge its real estate business, as per SEBI listing regulations. The announcement serves as an intimation under Regulations 30 and 51 of the Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements. This move separates the real estate operations from Vedanta's core business structure.

headline: Scheme of Arrangement
summary: Vedanta Limited's board has approved a scheme to demerge its real estate business into a separate entity, Vedanta Property Platforms Limited, to unlock value. The demerged business, which includes land, built-up assets, and related investments, generated a turnover of just INR 1.26 crore (0.001% of Vedanta's total turnover) in the last fiscal year. The move aims to enable focused management and improve transparency for the real estate portfolio, which has historically been underutilized within the larger metals and mining conglomerate.

headline: Press Release
summary: Vedanta Limited's Board has approved the demerger of its Real Estate Business into Vedanta Property Platforms Limited to unlock value. The real estate division, which generated a turnover of just INR 1.26 crore (0.001% of Vedanta's total) in the last fiscal year, will be transferred on a going concern basis. The move aims to enable focused management and better value realization from Vedanta's non-core property portfolio, subject to regulatory approvals.

headline: Copy of Newspaper Publication
summary: Somany Ceramics Limited has announced a newspaper publication regarding a petition hearing scheduled for 28th August 2026. This hearing follows an order from the National Company Law Tribunal (Kolkata Bench) dated 21st July 2026, concerning the company's Scheme of Amalgamation. The notice provides public information about the upcoming tribunal proceedings.

headline: General Updates
summary: Zensar Technologies has completed all regulatory filings for the merger of its US-based step-down subsidiary, Bridgeview Life Sciences LLC, into Zensar Technologies Inc., effective August 1, 2026. The company received confirmation of this on July 31, 2026. Filings for the merger of M3BI LLC with Zensar Technologies Inc. are still in progress.

headline: Scheme of Arrangement
summary: The Board of Avonmore Capital & Management Services Limited approved a draft Scheme of Amalgamation to merge four of its wholly-owned subsidiaries—Almondz Finanz, Apricot Infosoft, Avonmore Developer, and Anemone Holdings—into the company. The merger is subject to necessary approvals and will be conducted under Sections 230-232 of the Companies Act, 2013. The announcement was made in compliance with SEBI Listing Regulations, with the board meeting concluding at 1:35 p.m. on July 31, 2026.

headline: Scheme of Arrangement
summary: GAIL (India) Limited's Board has approved a scheme of arrangement to merge its wholly-owned subsidiary, Konkan LNG Limited (KLL), into itself. The merger aims to create a larger, vertically integrated entity and simplify the group structure to enhance operational efficiencies. As KLL is a wholly-owned subsidiary, its shares will be cancelled upon the scheme becoming effective, with no change to GAIL's shareholding.

headline: Updates
summary: India Glycols Limited has provided a material update to the stock exchanges regarding its subsidiary, Ennature Bio Pharma Limited, in connection with a Scheme of Arrangement. This update follows observation letters issued by NSE and BSE on 17th and 19th November 2025, respectively. The company is responding to the exchanges' observations as part of the regulatory process.

headline: Amalgamation/Merger
summary: PPAP Automotive Limited has received an order from the NCLT regarding the amalgamation of Avinya Batteries Limited with the company. The tribunal has dispensed with the need for a shareholders' meeting of Avinya Batteries but has directed meetings for its secured and unsecured creditors, as well as for the shareholders and creditors of PPAP Automotive. The company will now proceed to convene these meetings as per the tribunal's directives.

company: Clean Max Enviro Energy Solutions Limited
headline: Amalgamation/Merger
summary: Clean Max Enviro Energy Solutions Limited's Board approved a scheme to amalgamate its four wholly-owned subsidiaries into itself, dissolving them without winding up. Since the subsidiaries are wholly owned, no new shares or cash consideration will be issued under the scheme. The merger is subject to regulatory approvals, including sanction from the National Company Law Tribunal.

headline: Amalgamation/Merger
summary: TCC Concept Limited's Board approved a Scheme of Amalgamation to merge its wholly-owned subsidiary, ALTRR Software Services Limited, into itself by absorption. The merger is subject to regulatory approvals, including from the National Company Law Tribunal, and is classified as a related party transaction, though it is exempt from certain provisions. ALTRR, which focuses on AI-backed real estate solutions, will be absorbed into TCC, a diversified technology enterprise.

headline: General Updates
summary: JSW Steel Limited announced that its Scheme of Amalgamation with three transferor companies—Amba River Coke Limited, Monnet Cement Limited, and JSW Retail and Distribution Limited—has become effective as of August 1, 2026. The scheme's appointed date is April 1, 2026, following the filing of the final and rectified orders from the National Company Law Tribunal with the Registrar of Companies in Mumbai.

headline: Allotment of Securities
summary: Orchid Pharma Limited has allotted 4,45,86,052 fully paid-up equity shares to the eligible shareholders of Dhanuka Laboratories Limited, pursuant to the scheme of amalgamation. Following this allotment and the cancellation of cross-holdings, the company's paid-up share capital now stands at Rs. 59,88,52,000, comprising 5,98,85,200 equity shares. The newly issued shares will be listed on BSE and NSE and rank pari-passu with existing shares.

headline: Other Restructuring
summary: UPL Limited has completed the Swap Transaction and ESOP Swap Transaction, which were part of a larger restructuring scheme, following receipt of CCI approval. As a result, employee stock options in UPL Cayman 2 were exchanged for new options in UPL Cayman 1, and the shareholding structure of UPL Cayman 1 has been diversified to include the Upswing Trust and other holders. The scheme's effectiveness remains pending the fulfilment of other conditions precedent.

headline: Amalgamation/Merger
summary: MPS Limited announced a two-step merger to consolidate its subsidiaries, American Journal Experts (AJE-NC and AJE-DE), into its wholly-owned subsidiary, MPS North America LLC. The first step, merging AJE-NC into AJE-DE, became effective on 01 August 2026, with the second step merging AJE-DE into MPS North America LLC to follow, making MPS North America LLC the final surviving entity. This internal restructuring will consolidate all assets, rights, and liabilities of the AJE entities into MPS North America LLC.

company: Jubilant Agri and Consumer Products Limited
headline: General Updates
summary: Jubilant Agri and Consumer Products Limited has scheduled a meeting of its Unsecured Creditors for September 05, 2026, to seek approval for its proposed Scheme of Arrangement for Demerger, as directed by the NCLT, Allahabad Bench. The company has dispatched the meeting notice and explanatory statement to creditors with outstanding debts exceeding Rs. 1,00,000 as of March 31, 2026. The notice and related documents are also available on the company's website.

company: Jubilant Agri and Consumer Products Limited
headline: Shareholders meeting
summary: Jubilant Agri and Consumer Products Limited has convened a meeting of its equity shareholders on September 5, 2026, to seek approval for a proposed Scheme of Arrangement for demerger, as directed by the NCLT, Allahabad Bench. The meeting will be held at the company's registered office in Gajraula, Uttar Pradesh, with remote e-voting available from September 2 to September 4, 2026. Notices and related documents have been dispatched to shareholders as of August 1, 2026, and are also available on the company's website.

headline: Other Restructuring
summary: Reliance Industries announced that its step-down subsidiary, Radisys Cayman Limited, has been merged into its holding company, Radisys International LLC, effective July 31, 2026. The merger, involving entities incorporated in the Cayman Islands and Delaware respectively, is part of an internal restructuring. No other operational or financial details were disclosed.

headline: Scheme of Arrangement
summary: Triveni Engineering & Industries Limited has announced the allocation of the cost of acquisition of its equity shares and those of Triveni Power Transmission Limited (TPTL) following a Scheme of Arrangement. Under the scheme, 86.60% of the cost is allocated to Triveni Engineering shares, while 13.40% is allocated to TPTL shares. This allocation is made in accordance with the Income-Tax Act, 2025, and has been published on the company’s website.

company: Sab Events & Governance Now Media Limited
headline: Suspension of Trading
summary: Trading in equity shares of Sab Events & Governance Now Media Limited will be suspended starting August 05, 2026. This suspension is due to a reduction in share capital ordered by the NCLT. The announcement serves as formal notice to exchange members.

headline: Amalgamation/Merger
summary: Allied Blenders and Distillers Limited has provided an update on its scheme of amalgamation, which involves merging two entities—Deccan Star Distilleries India Private Limited and Sarthak Blenders & Bottlers Private Limited—into itself. The merger is structured as an absorption, where the two transferor companies will be dissolved without liquidation, with their shareholders becoming shareholders of Allied Blenders. This consolidation aims to streamline operations and integrate the businesses under a single corporate entity.

headline: Amalgamation/Merger
summary: Godrej Properties Limited's Board approved a Scheme of Amalgamation to merge its indirect wholly-owned subsidiary, Godrej Housing Projects Private Limited, into the company. The merger is subject to necessary approvals from the NCLT and other regulatory authorities. Godrej Properties currently holds 95% of the subsidiary's equity, with the remaining 5% held by another wholly-owned subsidiary.

headline: Outcome of Board Meeting
summary: UNO Minda Limited's Board approved a Scheme of Amalgamation to merge its subsidiary, Minda Onkyo India Pvt. Ltd., with itself. The merger is subject to statutory approvals, including from shareholders, creditors, and the National Company Law Tribunal. The company will file the scheme with stock exchanges as per SEBI regulations.

headline: Amalgamation/Merger
summary: UNO Minda Limited’s board has approved a scheme to amalgamate its subsidiary, Minda Onkyo India Pvt. Ltd., into the parent company. The merger is subject to regulatory, shareholder, and creditor approvals, including clearance from the National Company Law Tribunal. The move is considered a related-party transaction but does not require compliance with Section 188 of the Companies Act.

company: Jubilant Agri and Consumer Products Limited
headline: Copy of Newspaper Publication
summary: Jubilant Agri and Consumer Products Limited has informed the stock exchange about a newspaper publication regarding a notice for a meeting of equity shareholders and unsecured creditors, convened by the Hon'ble NCLT. The notice pertains to this scheduled meeting as part of the company's corporate proceedings.

headline: Other Restructuring
summary: BASF India’s Board has approved the closure of its sulfation and low-temperature reactor plants for the Care Chemicals business at the Dahej site, citing market overcapacities and margin pressure. The shutdown is expected by the end of 2026, pending approvals, while the business will continue other operations in India. In FY 2025-26, these plants contributed Rs. 542 crore, or 4% of the company’s total revenue.

headline: Agreements
summary: Belrise Industries Limited has approved the acquisition of the India tipper body business of Hyva (India) Pvt. Ltd. through a Business Transfer Agreement. The deal is valued at USD 5.65 million (approximately INR 543.88 million).

headline: Scheme of Arrangement
summary: Larsen & Toubro Limited has disclosed the voting results and Scrutinizer’s Report from the NCLT-convened equity shareholders’ meeting held on August 4, 2026, regarding its Scheme of Arrangement. The announcement provides a summary of the proceedings and confirms the outcome of the shareholder vote on the scheme.

headline: Shareholders meeting
summary: Larsen & Toubro has informed the exchange about the proceedings of its NCLT-convened shareholders' meeting held on August 4, 2026. The company has also submitted the Scrutinizer's report along with the voting results.

headline: Amalgamation/Merger
summary: Pondy Oxides & Chemicals Limited (POCL) has approved a scheme to amalgamate its wholly-owned subsidiary, Harsha Exito Engineering Private Limited (HEEPL), with itself. The merger aims to consolidate business operations, assets, and liabilities, and is subject to approval from the National Company Law Tribunal, shareholders, and creditors. The transaction is classified as a related party transaction but does not require compliance with Section 188 of the Companies Act, as no consideration is involved.

headline: Amalgamation/Merger
summary: Ventive Hospitality Limited has announced the merger of Sun Leisure (India) Private Limited into Soham Leisure Ventures Private Limited, as per SEBI Listing Regulations. The intimation was made under Regulation 30, detailing the amalgamation process. This move consolidates the company's leisure and hospitality assets under a single entity.

headline: Amalgamation/Merger
summary: Mahindra & Mahindra Financial Services Limited (MMFSL) has approved a scheme to merge its subsidiary, Mahindra Rural Housing Finance Limited (MRHFL), into itself. The merger aims to consolidate their lending operations into a single platform to simplify operations and enhance growth. The scheme is subject to regulatory approvals, with an appointed date of April 1, 2027.

headline: General Updates
summary: Adani Power Limited has received approval from the NCLT Ahmedabad for the amalgamation of its nine wholly-owned subsidiaries, with the scheme's appointed date set as April 1, 2025. The order was issued on August 4, 2026, though the process for one subsidiary, VIPL, remains pending before the NCLT Mumbai. The scheme will become effective once all required steps are completed, and the company will update the exchanges accordingly.

headline: Amalgamation/Merger
summary: Crisil Limited has completed the amalgamation of its wholly owned step-down subsidiaries, Crisil Canada Inc. and Crisil PriceMetrix Inc., into a single entity, Crisil PriceMetrix Inc., effective August 1, 2026. The Certificate of Amalgamation was received on August 5, 2026, marking the completion of all related formalities.

headline: Amalgamation/Merger
summary: TVS Motor Company has announced a composite scheme of amalgamation involving Home Credit India Finance, STPL Trading and Services, TVS Housing Finance, and TVS Credit Services, along with their shareholders. The merger aims to consolidate these entities under a unified structure. The proposal has been communicated to the stock exchange.

headline: Amalgamation/Merger
summary: TVS Holdings has announced that its subsidiary, Home Credit India Finance, along with other group entities, has approved a composite scheme of amalgamation. The scheme involves merging STPL Trading and Services and TVS Housing Finance into Home Credit India, which will then merge into TVS Credit Services. The merger is subject to regulatory approvals from the RBI, CCI, stock exchanges, and the NCLT.

headline: Amalgamation/Merger
summary: Aurobindo Pharma announced that its Board approved a proposal to file a Scheme of Amalgamation with the NCLT, merging two step-down subsidiaries, Eugia Steriles and Eugia SEZ, into its wholly-owned subsidiary, Eugia Pharma Specialities. The consolidation aims to simplify the group structure, reduce overheads, and achieve synergy benefits by merging three companies engaged in manufacturing injectable pharmaceuticals. As the merger involves only wholly-owned subsidiaries, no consideration is involved, and the company's shareholding pattern remains unchanged.

headline: Amalgamation/Merger
summary: The Sandesh Limited's Board approved the Scheme of Amalgamation to merge its subsidiary, Sandesh Digital Private Limited, into the company, subject to regulatory approvals. Additionally, the Board approved the unaudited financial results for the quarter ended June 30, 2026, and fixed August 14, 2026, as the record date for the final dividend of Rs. 5 per share. The Board also approved the continued appointment of Non-Executive Director Smt. Pannaben F. Patel beyond the age of 75, pending shareholder approval.

headline: Scheme of Arrangement
summary: Marathon Nextgen Realty Limited has announced that, per an NCLT order dated July 2, 2026, it will hold separate meetings for its Equity Shareholders and Unsecured Creditors on September 7, 2026, at 11:00 a.m. and 12:30 p.m., respectively. These meetings are convened to consider and approve the company's Scheme of Arrangement.

headline: Shareholders meeting
summary: Marathon Nextgen Realty Limited has informed the exchange of a creditors' meeting scheduled for September 7, 2026, at 12:30 p.m. This meeting, convened by the NCLT Mumbai Bench, is for the company's unsecured creditors. The notice follows an NCLT order dated July 2, 2026.

headline: Shareholders meeting
summary: Marathon Nextgen Realty Limited has informed the exchange of a shareholders' meeting scheduled for September 7, 2026, at 11:00 a.m. The meeting is being convened as per the order of the National Company Law Tribunal (NCLT), Mumbai Bench, dated July 2, 2026.

headline: Shareholders meeting
summary: Refex Industries Limited has informed the stock exchanges about the proceedings of its NCLT-convened meetings with equity shareholders, secured creditors, and unsecured creditors, held on August 5, 2026. The intimation was made under Regulation 30 of the SEBI Listing Regulations. No specific outcomes or resolutions were disclosed in the announcement.

headline: News Verification
summary: The exchange has requested clarification from Vedanta Aluminium Metal Limited regarding a news report claiming the company plans to raise Rs 13,500 crore from Axis, HDFC, and ICICI Bank post-demerger. The company’s official response is still pending.

headline: News Verification
summary: Vedanta Aluminium Metal Limited clarified to the exchange regarding a news report claiming it would raise Rs 13,500 crore from Axis, HDFC, and ICICI Bank post-demerger. The company’s official response to the exchange’s query is attached in the announcement. No further details on the clarification’s content were provided in the summary.

company: Swan Defence and Heavy Industries Limited
headline: General Updates
summary: Swan Defence and Heavy Industries Limited has announced that the National Company Law Tribunal (Ahmedabad Bench) has sanctioned the Scheme of Arrangement and Amalgamation involving Triumph Offshore Private Limited and the company. The approval covers the merger and its effects on the respective shareholders and creditors of both entities.

headline: Disclosure of material issue
summary: Cellecor Gadgets Limited announced that its Board of Directors approved the migration of its equity shares from the NSE Emerge platform to the main boards of both NSE and BSE, subject to regulatory and shareholder approvals. The Board also approved the introduction of an Employee Stock Option Plan (ESOP 2026) for the grant of 50 lakh options to eligible employees. Additionally, the company approved a leadership restructuring, including the transition of Mr. Nikhil Aggarwal from Whole Time Director to National Sales Head.

headline: General Updates
summary: Religare Enterprises Limited announced that the Reserve Bank of India (RBI) has declined to grant its no-objection or prior approval for the proposed Scheme of Arrangement to demerge its undertaking into Religare Finvest Limited. This decision was communicated to both companies via letters dated August 6 and 7, 2026. REL and RFL plan to engage with the regulator to provide further clarifications on the matter.

headline: Amalgamation/Merger
summary: Ugro Capital Limited has informed the stock exchanges that the National Company Law Tribunal (NCLT), via an order dated August 6, 2026, has directed the company to convene meetings of its equity shareholders, secured creditors, and unsecured creditors. These meetings are being held to consider and approve the proposed Scheme of Amalgamation. The disclosure was made under Regulation 30 of the SEBI Listing Regulations.

headline: General Updates
summary: NHPC Limited has informed stock exchanges that the Ministry of Corporate Affairs has scheduled a hearing on 25.08.2026 regarding the scheme of amalgamation between its wholly-owned subsidiary, Jalpower Corporation Limited, and NHPC Limited. This update follows the company's previous communication dated 29.09.2025 and is made in compliance with SEBI regulations. Further updates on the matter will be shared in due course.

headline: Shareholders meeting
summary: Refex Industries Limited has submitted the voting results and consolidated Scrutinizer’s Report from the court-convened shareholder and creditor meetings held on August 5, 2026. These meetings were conducted to approve the Composite Scheme of Amalgamation & Arrangement involving Refex Green Mobility Limited, Refex Industries Limited, and Refex Mobility Limited. The submission marks a key procedural step in the scheme's approval process.

headline: Updates
summary: KSS Limited has informed the stock exchange about a consequential order passed by the NCLT Mumbai Bench on 5th August 2026, under Regulation 30 of the SEBI Listing Regulations. This order gives effect to the previously approved Resolution Plan for the company, which is undergoing the Corporate Insolvency Resolution Process.

headline: Other Restructuring
summary: Renaissance Global Limited has announced an internal corporate restructuring approved by its Board on August 7, 2026, aimed at simplifying its global footprint and optimizing its cross-border holding structure. The plan involves transferring stakes in Renaissance FMI Inc (USA) and Renaissance Global Brands Inc (USA) through share swap and purchase agreements, ultimately making RFMI a wholly-owned subsidiary of RGBI, and RGBI a wholly-owned subsidiary of Renaissance Retail Limited (India). No benefits to promoters or promoter group companies were reported from this restructuring.

headline: Amalgamation/Merger

The merger aims to simplify the group's holding structure, unlock the potential of OHL's portfolio, and drive long-term value creation for shareholders.

Shah Commerce Education Limited (JSCEL), which will become an independently listed company. Once effective, JSCEL will house all of Veranda's commerce education brands, positioning it for accelerated growth and enhanced shareholder value.

The all-stock transaction proposes a share exchange ratio of 25 IHCL shares for every 117 OHL shares, with completion targeted for the second half of FY2028. The merger aims to simplify the group's holding structure, unlock the potential of OHL's portfolio, and drive long-term value creation.

The deal strengthens the group's position in ammonia storage to meet demand from fertilizer, industrial, and energy transition customers.

headline: Scheme of Arrangement
summary: Inox Green Energy Services Limited announced that its IRSL Committee has allotted 4,89,82,030 fully paid-up equity shares to eligible shareholders as per the Scheme of Arrangement. IRSL is now working to credit these shares to shareholders' demat accounts and obtain listing and trading approvals from stock exchanges.

headline: Record Date
summary: HEG Limited has fixed September 7, 2026, as the record date for determining shareholders eligible to receive consideration under its Scheme with the resulting company, HEG Graphite Limited. The date was set in consultation with HEG Graphite Limited. This applies to shareholders of HEG Limited as of that date.
